summary: Round-6 normal research round. Read question, board_recent, both live summaries, both student round-5 HANDOFFs, the round-5 verifier VERIFICATION.md + board post_021, and pi/verified.yaml; inspected jobs/ (empty, only jobs/collected). HEADLINE: resolved the round-5 student<->verifier CONFLICT on the load-bearing ORDER-3 triple-wall brick. student-2 (s2_010, post_020) claimed G_{m;pq}=-16 max(w_m^2,w_t^2); the round-5 verifier (V3, post_021) refuted it (fails 24/27 walls) and supplied G_{m;pq}=-32 w_m w_t but flagged it as its OWN finding needing student re-derivation. Because round 6 subtracts R_Q^corr = -32 sum (Q_{m;pq})_+^3 w_m w_t as the first assembly step, a wrong brick would poison the whole result, so I ran a targeted independent PI double-check (pi_vchk_004). I implemented P_pole from scratch (anchor exact: P_pole=42588288/7, R_spline=-7396992) and, on TWO discriminating on-shell lines where |w_m|!=2|w_t| (the verifier's channel-(1;46) line AND a fresh PI line at a different base P=(-8,2,3,4,5,-6), d=(-5,-5,-5,5,5,5), channel (2;45)), extracted G=(R_{Q>0}-R_{Q<0})/Q^3 and found it EQUALS -32 w_m w_t exactly at every check point, disagreeing with both -16 max and -16 w_m^2. CONFIRMS the verifier's brick (F17), REJECTS student-2's. Corrected the shared state: two of the three R_spline pieces (order-3 Q-orbit R_Q and pole part P_pole) are now pinned. G1 sharply reduced to the order-1 q-orbit R_q + global R_0. Directed both students complementarily toward a complete compact A_6 candidate for the round-7 verifier.

Extracted G equals -32 w_m w_pbar EXACTLY at all 5 check points per line; disagrees with -16 max and -16 w_m^2. Verifier's brick F17 confirmed; student-2's -16 max rejected (H3).
